date_note: Vanguard's article of 24 November gives no earlier day for the raid.
exec: Nigeria's Police Special Fraud Unit reports arresting 11 suspected internet fraudsters in Ogun State.
org: Police Special Fraud Unit (PSFU), Nigeria Police Force
plain: Nigerian police say they raided a house in Abeokuta and arrested 11 suspected internet fraudsters. Police say the group used the personal details of foreign nationals to defraud people online.

sources.name: Vanguard: Police arrest 11 suspected yahoo boys in Ogun, recover charms

evidence.quote: has arrested 11 suspected internet fraudsters during an intelligence-led raid

summary: The Police Special Fraud Unit said it arrested 11 suspected internet fraudsters in a raid on a house in Abeokuta, Ogun State. According to the police statement reported by Vanguard, the suspects exploited the identities and personal details of foreign nationals to defraud victims online. Police also reported recovering suspected fetish materials, phones, laptops and a vehicle. The alleged leader is reported to be at large.
title: Nigerian police say they arrested 11 suspected internet fraudsters in Abeokuta, Ogun State

validation.note: Vanguard only, relaying a Police Special Fraud Unit statement; no police release read.

review.note: stronger than the source: admitted exploiting changed to exploited (police say); rest checked against Vanguard
